description: This file defines a mock class for the IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient interface used in testing WebAudioPlayer IPC communication within the Rialto client component. It includes necessary headers, declares the mock class with a mocked method notifyState, and is part of the firebolt::rialto::client namespace.
